summary.text: David DiPietro is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly representing District 147, which he has represented since January 1, 2013, and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: DiPietro earned a B.S. in business administration from Wittenburg University in 1985.
His professional experience includes owning Sparkle Cleaners.
For the 2025-2026 session, DiPietro was assigned to the Aging, Banks, Correction and Labor committees.
